disabled: post_execution/reroute: no sound post-execution re-dispatch exists in this runtime. The agent cannot dispatch tools -- only the orchestrator does -- so a repair would have to rewrite the returned ToolMessage, and the orchestrator holds that same object and has already recorded it. An in-place rewrite corrupts the trajectory the evaluator replays through Environment.set_state; the earlier hand-authored version of exactly this turned 41 of 114 telecom simulations into infrastructure errors.
